ModMetaData.name: Stormproof
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
The Rim does not care about your freezer. Stormproof is the Power-tab toolkit that keeps a colony running through flares, lightning, EMP, fallout, heat, cold, and drought.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Odyssey optional. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: deconstruct every Stormproof building.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/stormproof Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
